column1: # Directories allowed to hold committed documents (.xlsx .xls .docx .doc .pdf).
# Rules, and why they are these rules:
#  * A reason is MANDATORY. An allow-list with reasons stays maintained; a pile of
#    unexplained paths is how a check gets quietly switched off.
#  * Entries are DIRECTORIES, never individual filenames. A directory entry is a visible
#    policy decision in the diff that adds it; a filename entry is a single file slipped
#    into a list where the next reader cannot tell it apart from the rest.
#  * Scope is the directory and everything under it. A sibling sharing a name prefix is
#    NOT covered (`docs/t/` does not allow `docs/theft/`) — asserted in the self-test.
#  * This file lives at the repository root, NOT under .github/, so adding a legitimate
#    document directory does not touch the CI directory. Every edit to a workflow file is
#    a chance for a wrong-side conflict resolution to delete a gate while tests stay green.
#  * PREFER REMOVING THE FILE OVER ADDING AN ENTRY. An exemption is a debt with no due
#    date: a later reader has to re-judge it forever.
